description: Nika Diamond — evolving DX settings (WAVE 1 hardened 2026-04-14 + HQ dashboard wired 2026-04-14)

hooks.command: INPUT=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE 'git push[[:space:]]+.*(--force|-f)\b'; then echo '❌ FORBIDDEN: git push --force. Main branch is read-only. Would destroy history.' >&2; exit 2; fi

INPUT=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE '^git add (-A|\.|\*)'; then echo '❌ FORBIDDEN: git add -A/./*. Stage explicit paths only (nika-invariants.md Rule 9).' >&2; exit 2; fi

INPUT=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE 'cargo test[[:space:]]+--test\b'; then echo '❌ FORBIDDEN: cargo test --test triggers macOS Keychain popup. Use --lib only (feedback_no_keychain_popup.md).' >&2; exit 2; fi

INPUT=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+(checkout|switch)[[:space:]]+main\b'; then echo '❌ FORBIDDEN: main is read-only. Use `git show main:path` instead.' >&2; exit 2; fi

INPUT=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE '(git commit|git push).*--no-verify'; then echo '❌ FORBIDDEN: --no-verify bypasses hooks. Fix the underlying issue.' >&2; exit 2; fi
FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '/\.git/'; then echo '❌ FORBIDDEN: editing inside .git/ directory.' >&2; exit 2; fi

CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^git commit' && git log -1 --format=%B 2>/dev/null | grep -qi 'Co-Authored-By: Claude'; then echo '❌ HEAD commit contains Co-Authored-By: Claude — forbidden. Use Nika 🦋 only. Amend before push.' >&2; exit 2; fi

CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^git commit'; then DASH=../hq/dashboard; if [ -d "$DASH" ]; then (cd "$DASH" && pnpm run collect >/dev/null 2>&1 &); curl -sf -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4321/api/invalidate >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; fi

CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^git commit' && git log -1 --format=%B 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'admit to workspace'; then printf '🆕 Crate admission detected.
  → Update MEMORY.md Quick State (HEAD + count + LOC)
  → Tag: git tag v0.90.0-alpha.N
  → Run hygiene dashboard
' >&2; ./scripts/hygiene/check-all.sh --quiet >&2 2>&1 || true; DASH=../hq/dashboard; if [ -d "$DASH" ]; then echo '🎨 Auto-regenerating status.mdx + snapshotting gitnexus graph...' >&2; (cd "$DASH" && pnpm run gen-status 2>&1 | head -5 >&2 && pnpm run snapshot 2>&1 | head -5 >&2) || true; fi; fi

CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^git push' && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(--force|-f)'; then HEAD=$(git log -1 --format=%h 2>/dev/null); echo "📤 Pushed. HEAD is now $HEAD — update MEMORY.md Quick State if this session ends." >&2; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -q '\.rs$' && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then LOC=$(wc -l < "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$LOC" -gt 1500 ]; then echo "⚠️ WARNING: $FILE has $LOC lines (>1500 cap per nika-invariants.md)" >&2; fi; fi

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null && HEAD=$(git log -1 --format=%h 2>/dev/null || echo ?); BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo ?); CRATES=$(ls tools/*/Cargo.toml 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo "💎 Nika Diamond — branch: $BRANCH | HEAD: $HEAD | crates admitted: $CRATES/40-42. Read MEMORY.md Quick State first."
cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null && if [ -x scripts/hygiene/check-all.sh ]; then RESULT=$(scripts/hygiene/check-all.sh --quiet 2>&1 | tail -1); echo "🩺 Hygiene: $RESULT"; fi

STATE=$(curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:4321/api/state 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$STATE" ]; then echo "$STATE" | jq -r '"🎛️  HQ LIVE — \(.short_head) · \(.crates_admitted)/\(.crates_target) crates · hygiene \(.hygiene_green)/\(.hygiene_total) GREEN · Phase \(.phase) · \(.session_current) \(.session_status) · Shadow \(.shadow_zones_resolved)/\(.shadow_zones_total) resolved"' 2>/dev/null || echo '🎛️  HQ LIVE (open http://localhost:4321)'; else echo '🎛️  HQ offline (start: cd ../hq/dashboard && pnpm dev)'; fi
echo '🦋 Session end. If crate admitted: update MEMORY.md Quick State + run scripts/hygiene/check-all.sh'
